Class FractionImpl

java.lang.Object
FractionImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
Fraction, Comparable<Fraction>
public class FractionImpl extends Object implements Fraction
A concrete implementation of Fraction representing a ratio of two integers. The denominator is always stored as a positive integer; if the fraction is negative, the numerator carries the negative sign.

  • Constructor Details

    • FractionImpl

      public FractionImpl(int numerator, int denominator)
      Constructs a FractionImpl with the given numerator and denominator. The fraction is immediately normalized: the denominator is forced positive (sign moved to numerator), and both terms are reduced to lowest form via the GCD.
      Parameters:
      numerator - any integer
      denominator - any non-zero integer; if negative the sign is absorbed into the numerator
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if denominator is zero
